data.title: NRx Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: NRXP) Reports Update from the FDA Revising Previous Major Amendment to a Minor Amendment for Preservative-free Ketamine
data.description: WILMINGTON, Del., Sept. 15, 2026 - NRx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. revealed that the FDA Office of Generic Drugs has reclassified the amendment to its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) from a Major to a Minor Amendment. The company received written communication confirming this change, marking a significant milestone. NRx Pharmaceuticals, listed as NRXP on Nasdaq, operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical firm. This regulatory development underscores progress in their application process, signaling a positive step forward for the company.

data.title: Radiant, Hydrated Skin and Longer-Lasting Fragrance from One Silicone-Free Sensory Enhancer
data.description: Inolex has introduced SustOleo™ Embrace, a sensory enhancer designed to leave skin glowing and moisturized. It effectively smooths dry, scaly skin after just one use and retains fragrance for a remarkable 20 hours. The product was launched in Philadelphia on September 15, 2026.

data.title: TypeSafe AI Emerges From Stealth With $40M in Funding With New Model for Composable AI
data.description: An AI lab named TypeSafe AI has recently come out of stealth mode in San Francisco. They specialize in creating machine-native and composable AI. The company has attracted significant attention with $40 million in seed funding, led by DCVC. TypeSafe AI was established by Diogo Almeida, a former researcher at OpenAI and co-inventor of RLHF/ChatGPT, along with Erik Gafni and Sasha Sheng. Their goal is to develop a novel form of intelligence that offers developers dependable and efficient solutions which can be seamlessly integrated into software systems. This emergence marks a new era in AI innovation as TypeSafe sets out to revolutionize the field with cutting-edge models.

data.title: Trialbee Launches AI Pre-Screening Agent in the Honey Platform™ to Help Patients Connect to Clinical Trials Faster
data.description: Trialbee, a global leader in patient recruitment for clinical trials, based in Malmö, Sweden and Wilmington, Delaware, has introduced an AI Pre-Screening Agent on its Honey Platform™, revolutionizing how patients engage with trials. This new agent provides patients with increased control in completing secondary screening, offering a quicker and more adaptable process in determining pre-qualification and participation. By engaging patients at their peak interest, Trialbee aims to enhance the trial experience. This advancement showcases Trialbee's commitment to leveraging technology and AI to drive innovation in the clinical trial space.

data.title: Applebee’s® and IHOP® Continue Nationwide Growth With New Dual-Branded Restaurant in San Antonio, TX
data.description: Dine Brands Global, Inc. (NYSE: DIN), the firm behind Applebee's Neighborhood Grill + Bar® and IHOP®, marks the successful growth of its dual-branded restaurant concept with the debut of a new site in San Antonio, TX. This milestone comes less than 2 years post launching the initial standalone U.S. dual-branded restaurant in nearby Seguin, Texas. The two prominent brands are near the 50 dual-branded locations mark across the country, showcasing increased customer interest in the concept.

data.title: The Inner Circle acknowledges Dr. Randi Johnson Hanson as a Pinnacle Professional Member Inner Circle of Excellence.

data.title: Halcyon Welcomes Nick Chaset to its Board as Independent Director
data.description: In San Francisco, the Energy AI platform Halcyon has announced the appointment of Nick Chaset as a new member of its board of directors. Chaset, who currently serves as the CEO of Octopus Energy US and Uplight, joins the board as the data center load continues to increase.

data.title: INK Communications Co. Named to PRNEWS’ 2027 Agency Elite Top 120 for Seventh Consecutive Year
data.description: In Austin, Texas, INK Communications Co., a PR agency in North America focusing on integrated communications for B2B technology and energy firms, has been included in PRNEWS' 2027 Agency Elite Top 120. This marks the company's seventh year in a row on the prestigious list. PRNEWS publishes this annual list to honor 120 PR and communications companies for their primary services, recent agency advancements, and achievements from the past year, such as business expansion and new clients.

data.title: Algorand's x402 Challenge offers $100K prize for pay-per-use innovations on Mainnet, with 500K ALGO. Details inside.
data.description: Developers are encouraged to participate in the x402 Challenge on the Algorand (ALGO) Mainnet. This challenge involves creating pay-per-use APIs and offers generous rewards of $100,000 and 500,000 ALGO. Interested individuals can find more information on how to get involved.
